items.docs:
API client specifies record ID or multiple IDs and fetches attributes for all those records.
Filtering & Sorting by Value is not supported.

To Create an attribute you must leave the id field empty. To Update you must specify the ID field. RecordID refers to the object that the attribute will be attached to. Product / invoice / customer, etc.
Name cannot have spaces and is limited to 50 characters. One database record must not have multiple attributes with the same name.
3 `types` are available - int, double, text. Based on the type the `value` should be number of text.
